short_summary.value: Stack data assembly and selection module that merges GRF and PSR data with PC and SP into a 96-bit output, driven by event handshake from RGRF and RPSR.
short_summary.explanation: The module receives drive events from RGRF and RPSR, merges their payload data (192-bit GRF data and 32-bit PSR data) with PC and SP into a 224-bit internal stack word, then selects a 96-bit slice (64-bit data + 32-bit address) for output based on a 2-bit selection number. It also manages free handshake signals for flow control.
